name: Eldercare & nursing homes (category guide)
summary: AIC nursing-home paths vs private eldercare for LTVP parents — citizen/PR subsidy gates, ADL assessments, and why an EP child’s salary does not unlock MOH residential LTC co-funding for a foreign parent.
body: MOH residential long-term-care subsidies and AIC-brokered nursing-home seats are built around Singapore Citizen / PR residents with means-tested household income — an EP child sponsoring a foreign parent on LTVP generally pays private rates. Start with a doctor or hospital medical social worker for care-needs (ADL) assessment; AIC Link helps citizens/PRs into subsidised queues, while private homes take direct applications with medical reports and deposits. Forum threads quote private beds in the low thousands SGD per month before add-ons; assume pre-existing conditions are poorly covered by LTVP medical insurance. Many EP households combine a live-in helper with day-care rather than jumping straight to institutional care — model rest-day backup honestly. Pair placement shopping with the aged-parent LTVP / PR guide and immigration counsel when the pass itself is the blocker. This is a category guide, not a ranked nursing-home list.
